brand.name: Burrow
brand.tagline: Your AI's memory, kept on your Mac
brand.sector: Local AI memory for the Mac (notes, documents, linked code, a ledger of AI decisions)

sentence.en: Every model that connects reads what you decided, and why.

set.name: Observatory
set.mechanism: Burrow is where you look at the sky from inside: an observatory dome with its slit open to one gold star, a reading-room serif for the name, Nebula violet with gold.
set.expression_move: The single gold star above the slit is the only warm colour.
set.differs_by: Obsidian is a violet crystal, Raycast a red diagonal, Bear an animal, Mem and Rewind soft gradient orbs; none is a place. This is a building you sit in, on black, with a serif name where the shelf uses geometric sans.

logo.concept: An observatory dome with its slit open: your own room, looking out at your own stars; the gold star is what the model read.
logo.defect: Slit and star on one axis read as a lower-case i; the star moved up and right of the dome and the slit off-centre.

defaults_used.why: Nebula violet is the app's existing default theme accent (palette kept), not a new choice.

rationale.claim: The app's chosen direction is 'Night Sky with Reading Room' (design/direction.md, 9 Nov); a dome is both.
A serif name sets Burrow apart from the geometric-sans shelf of AI tools.

findings.message: light: accent #ffd685 on background #ffffff is 1.38:1, below 3.0:1 (accent fill against the page (needs a label or border if lower); WCAG 2, no rounding)
light: link #8b5929 on text #1c1c1c is 2.89:1, below 3.0:1 (links distinguishable from body text without underline (WCAG G183); WCAG 2, no rounding)
ext-1 and ext-4 collapse to CIEDE2000 8.8 for protanopia; label variants and chart series, don't rely on colour alone
ext-1 and ext-4 collapse to CIEDE2000 4.6 for deutanopia; label variants and chart series, don't rely on colour alone
ext-2 and ext-4 collapse to CIEDE2000 8.2 for tritanopia; label variants and chart series, don't rely on colour alone
ext-2 and ext-5 collapse to CIEDE2000 3.4 for tritanopia; label variants and chart series, don't rely on colour alone
ext-4 #61b8ff and ext-5 #63d1ff are only CIEDE2000 9.6 apart; as variants or chart series they will be confused

suggested_fix.how: lighten by OKLCH L +0.01, same hue

findings.message: light: border #e6e6e6 on background #ffffff is 1.25:1, below 3.0:1 (borders: dividers are exempt, input outlines need 3:1; WCAG 2, no rounding)
dark: link #ffd685 on text #f3f3f3 is 1.24:1, below 3.0:1 (underline links in dark mode (WCAG G183: without underline a link needs 3:1 against body text); WCAG 2, no rounding)
dark: border #414141 on background #0f0f0f is 1.88:1, below 3.0:1 (borders: dividers are exempt, input outlines need 3:1; WCAG 2, no rounding)
#ffd685 sits at the sRGB gamut edge (100% of max chroma); vivid colours like this often fall outside CMYK process gamut: specify Lab D50 + tolerance, check with the printer, consider a spot colour
